description: This file defines a utility class 'Pipe' with static methods for composing and joining Akka stream processors, such as filters, sinks, and flows, using Akka Streams Java DSL.

classes.name: Pipe
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to join and compose Akka stream components such as filters, sinks, and flows.

methods.name: joinFilteredSink
methods.description: Joins a filter graph with a sink, attaching the sink to the filter's output port.

methods.name: joinUnhandledSink
methods.description: Joins a filter graph with a sink for unhandled messages, attaching the sink to the filter's unhandled port.

methods.name: joinFilteredFlow
methods.description: Attaches a flow into the output port of a filter graph, creating a combined fan-out shape.

methods.name: joinFlows
methods.description: Chains a collection of flows sequentially into a single flow.
